COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
26.06.2024 AO No.255 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The proposed Appeal has been filed 
challenging the Award dated 23.03.2024, 
passed by learned Motor Accident Claims 
Tribunal/VIth Additional District Judge, 
Dehradun in Motor Accident Claim 
Petition No.221 of 2018, by which, the 
learned Tribunal has awarded a total 
sum of Rs.55,73,542/-(Rupees Fifty Five 
Lakh Seventy Three Thousand Five 
Hundred Forty Two) as compensation 
along with an interest at the rate of 9% 
per annum from the date of petition till 
its actual payment. 
2. Heard Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned 
counsel for proposed appellant. 
3. Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate, submitted 
that on the date of the accident, the 
driver of the bus was not having a valid 
and effective driving license and the 
owner of the bus was not having a valid 
permit and fitness certificate.
4. As per the award, driving license 
and permit were filed before the 
Tribunal. 
5. List on 20.07.2024 with A.O. 
No.254 of 2024.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 26.06.2024
Neha

A.O. No. 255 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the 
appellant.
2. Issue notice to the respondents.
3. Steps to be taken within a week.
4. Meanwhile, Lower Court Record may 
also be summoned. 
5. Also heard on the Stay Application (IA 
No. 01 of 2024).
6. Having considered the submission of 
learned counsel for the appellant, it is 
directed that the effect and operation of the 
impugned judgement and award dated 
23.03.2024 passed by M.A.C.T./6th
Additional District Judge, Dehradun in 
M.A.C. 72 of 2018, Smt. Mathura Devi and 
another, vs. Sandeep Panwar and others, 
shall remain stayed, provided the
applicant/appellant deposits the entire 
awarded amount, excluding the statutory 
deposit, with the Tribunal concerned within a 
period of four weeks from today.
(Stay Application is disposed of). 
7. Connect this matter along with A.O. 
No. 254 of 2024.
 (Alok Mahra J.)
 20.02.2025 
 
Kaushal/Anand

Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. I. P. Kohli, learned counsel for the 
appellant/Insurance Company in both the appeals.
2. Mr. D. C. S. Rawat, learned counsel for the 
respondent nos. 1 & 2 in AO No. 254 of 2024.
3. Mr. Rajendra Arya, proxy counsel for Mr. Neeraj 
Garg, learned counsel for the respondent no. 4 in AO 
No. 254 of 2024 and learned counsel for the respondent 
no.2 in AO no. 255 of 2024. 
4. Mr. Raj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the 
respondent no.3 in AO no. 255 of 2024.
5. Mr. Pramod Bailwal, learned counsel fdor the 
respondent no. 4 in AO no. 255 of 2024.
6. Perusal of the order sheet would reflect that vide 
order dated 20.02.2025, time was granted to the 
appellant/Insurance Company to deposit the entire 
awarded amount with the Tribunal concerned but the 
same was not deposited by the appellant/Insurance 
Company. 
7. Time Extension Applications (IA No.03 and 02 of 
2025) are filed by the appellant/Insurance Company 
with prayer to grant further three weeks time to the 
appellant/Insurance Company to deposit the entire 
awarded amount before the learned Tribunal concerned. 
8. In view of the above, one week time is granted to 
the appellant/Insurance Company to deposit the entire 
awarded amount before the learned Tribunal concerned. 
9. List this matter on 11.07.2025.
10. Time Extension Applications (IA No.03 and 02 of 
2025) stand disposed of accordingly. 
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.)
 02.06.2025
Akash
